methods.description: Substitute a bracketed negative and complete addition after any multiplication.
Multiply bracketed negative values with positive or negative coefficients.
Retain the given negative value and subtract the resulting negative amount.
Square the bracketed negative value before multiplying its outside coefficient; contrast a squared whole product.
Replace every pronumeral with its own given value, then evaluate all products and sums.
Evaluate a negative cube and negative square using three/two equal factors before combining.
Evaluate the full numerator after bracketed substitution, then divide and retain an exact negative fraction.
Distinguish the square of a bracketed negative value from a separate minus sign outside the power.
